title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Service Levels: Placement, Crew, Handling and Merchandise Limits
content:
Every Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment is held at one of six service levels. The level fixes where the crew leaves the merchandise, how many crew members are sent, which handling the crew performs, whether an adult must be at the address, which merchandise the level can be booked for and the heaviest single item it accepts.

Each level is offered for purchases made as a Northgate In-Club Purchase or a Northgate Special Order, to an address within the level's farthest delivery distance. Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation is offered for major appliances and Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation for televisions.

## Placement, crew and handling

| Service level | Where the crew leaves the merchandise | Crew members sent | Unpacking | Assembly | Packaging removed from the home | Adult present throughout the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | At the curb or in the driveway | 1 | No | No | No | Not required |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | Inside the first door or in the garage | 2 | No | No | No | Required |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | In the room of the member's choice | 2 | No | No | No | Required |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | In the room of the member's choice | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Required |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | At the installation location | 2 | Yes | No | Yes | Required |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | At the installation location | 2 | Yes | No | Yes | Required |

Assembly means assembling furniture and fitness equipment that ships unassembled. Packaging removal means the crew takes the packaging away from the home.

## Merchandise the level carries

| Service level | Merchandise classes the level can be booked for | Heaviest single item accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Curbside Delivery | General merchandise; mattresses and furniture; grocery | 150 lb |
| Northgate Threshold Delivery | General merchandise; mattresses and furniture; major appliances; televisions | 300 lb |
| Northgate Room of Choice Delivery | General merchandise; mattresses and furniture; major appliances; televisions | 300 lb |
| Northgate White Glove Delivery | General merchandise; mattresses and furniture | 400 lb |
| Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation | Major appliances | 500 lb |
| Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation | Televisions | 250 lb |

## Reading the schedule

- Only Northgate Curbside Delivery sends a single crew member and leaves the merchandise outside; it is also the only level at which no adult needs to be present.
- Northgate White Glove Delivery is the only level that assembles merchandise; it unpacks and removes packaging as well.
- Northgate Room of Choice Delivery and Northgate White Glove Delivery both leave the merchandise in the room of the member's choice, but only White Glove unpacks, assembles and removes packaging.
- Grocery appears only at Northgate Curbside Delivery. Major appliances appear at Threshold, Room of Choice and Appliance Delivery & Installation; televisions at Threshold, Room of Choice and TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation.

**Hypothetical reading.** A single item weighing 350 lb is heavier than the 300 lb that Threshold and Room of Choice accept and within the 400 lb of White Glove and the 500 lb of Appliance Delivery & Installation. An item of exactly 300 lb is not heavier than the Threshold and Room of Choice limit.
